guides.title: Monster Movement
content: At the start of its turn, a monster finds a focus, which is the enemy it can get in range to attack using the least movement.
This is independent of line-of-sight or current attack ability.
Monsters calculate paths through the fewest possible traps.
Tie-breakers for focus use the earliest initiative order.
**Movement Rules:**
Monsters move to get in range for their focus and maximize their attack.
They move the minimum amount required to maximize this attack.
Ranged monsters move away from their focus to avoid Disadvantage from adjacency if possible.
If a monster is already in range and lacks Disadvantage, it will not move.
Players decide movement for any equal viable options.

guides.title: Finding Focus
content: At the start of its turn, each monster must find a focus.
The focus is the enemy it can get in range to attack using the least movement, ignoring line-of-sight.
**Tie-breakers (in order):**
1. Closest enemy (fewest hexes to reach)
2. Enemy with the lowest initiative value
3. If still tied, players choose
**Important:** Focus calculation considers the monster current attack ability, but ignores whether it can actually attack this round (e.g., due to card abilities).

guides.title: Line of Sight (LoS)
content: **Targeted abilities** require the target to be in line-of-sight.
**Drawing LoS:**
LoS exists if a line can be drawn from any part of the attacker hex to any part of the target hex without touching a wall line.
**What blocks LoS:**
- Walls (thick dark lines on the map)
- Closed doors (act as walls until opened)
**What does NOT block LoS:**
- Obstacles
- Objectives
- Other figures
**Edge cases:**
- Corners touching walls do NOT block LoS (the line must touch a wall, not just a corner)

guides.title: Advantage & Disadvantage
content: **Advantage:** Roll two attack dice and use the higher result.
**When to apply Advantage:**
- Attacking from an elevated position (on a boulder, table, wall)
- Specific abilities grant it
- Shield spell on the attacker
**Disadvantage:** Roll two attack dice and use the lower result.
**When to apply Disadvantage:**
- Attacking from a lower position
- Ranged attack while adjacent to an enemy
- Target is Invisible
- Specific abilities grant it
**Important:** Both conditions can apply simultaneously, canceling each other out (normal roll).
